subject.title: refactor(ui): use Web Awesome controls throughout Control UI

question: After correcting theme initialization and refreshing the branch, should OpenClaw accept Web Awesome 3.10.0 plus the measured startup-budget increase as the canonical Control UI composite-control layer?
rationale: The architectural direction is established, but accepting a new runtime dependency and permanent startup-cost increase across nearly every Control UI interaction is a repository-level tradeoff that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept after targeted fixes
options.body: Fix the root theme contract, refresh the merge result, verify representative real-browser flows, and accept the measured dependency and startup cost.

options.title: Split high-risk surfaces
options.body: Land shared adapters and lower-risk controls first, then migrate complex dialogs, menus, and Workboard surfaces through smaller follow-ups.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Retain the merged accessibility foundation and defer the runtime dependency if its startup or review cost is unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept after targeted fixes
recommendation.body: Fix the root theme contract, refresh the merge result, verify representative real-browser flows, and accept the measured dependency and startup cost.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged foundation, owns the current migration direction, and is identified by the dependency guard as a trusted repository administrator.
